items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: So the thing that -- what happened, after I met the girl, she was such a beautiful person and so intelligent I couldn't believe it.

ctx.x: So the thing that -- what happened, after I met the girl, she was such a beautiful person and so intelligent I couldn't believe it. And she was such a wonderful person, so I said, "Charles you couldn't have married a better person." Well, she turned out to be the head of the family.
Well, I'll be darned. Isn't that -- you never do quite know why things happen, do you.
